draft_entry.summary: Meta Inc. released Muse Spark Open, an 816B total parameter open weights model with 42B active parameters and 1M token context length. The model is natively multimodal, accepting text, image, video, and audio inputs, and produces text outputs. It is available as open weights under the Muse Model License with restrictions on Model as a Service deployment above specified revenue thresholds.
